nom: The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% for Wrinkles and Skin Elasticity

avis.texte: one of my favorite products, leave my skin feeling polish and wrinkles smoother. very affordable, will definitely buy it again.

I noticed incredible plumpness and hydration in my skin by the very second day of using this product. I'm usually skeptical about skincare working this fast, but this actually happened and only with TO Copper Peptides! I have sensitive, combination skin, and this product dramatically calms it down while reducing fine lines. I've gone through 7 or 8 bottles now. I seriously can't live without it!
Good product however the bottle is only good after being open for 6 months which means I end up wasting a good portion of it. Not worth it in that case.

Makes my face sticky. Not a true serum. The cost is ridiculous especially for products advertise to be no frills. This doesn't feel good on your face and it doesn't work. It's causing acne at 60 + year's old. Terrible products Doesn't work.

avis.titre: Results So Fast I Can't Believe It!
avis.texte: After two days of using twice a day, I already felt my skin was softer. After three days, my skin texture was visibly improved, and after six days, it was significantly visibly improved! It's so soft, glowy, and youthful I can't believe it!

avis.titre: I just love this product. Its a gem in 40s.
avis.texte: I just love this product. If you use this you dont need any other antioxidants like vitamin c. I have tried soo many products but this one works and shows relaults instantly. My skin has evened out and looks so glowing and smooth. I am 42 years old with sensitive combination skin. I recommend this to all. This can replace lots of ur products.

avis.titre: Seems to be working for acne - no smell or issues
avis.texte: Was nervous to buy after reading poor reviews, which must be based on a bad product that was damaged by heat. Has no meat smell, and really no smell at all. Does not flake up. Melts into skin. Does not cause irritation. Acne already reduced overnight.

I'm reintroducing peptides after getting used to prescription retinol. This is one of them. I'm on my second bottle and cannot tell if it's doing anything yet, but I know it's worked n many other people, so here's hoping
After all the hype with Ordinary products, I gave them a try. I did used morning and night and did not notice any difference in my skin. I would not recommend this product.

avis.titre: Works but hard to get it not to pill
avis.texte: Some days this works great but most of the time it just pills off once i apply lotion. I do feel like its helped my skin but its so hard to use it properly.

I really looked forward to using this. I added this to my night time regimen with no other actives. I had some breakouts and dryness the first night. Unfortunately, by my second application (2nd night), I experienced itching, redness, burning, and irritation. It was so uncomfortable, I had to wash it off with a gentle cleanser and use a steroid cream. For reference, my skin is combo, sensitve/reactive, and prone to acne. If you have sensitive skin, reactive skin, eczema prone skin, or rosacea, please patch test and proceed with caution.

There are things I liked about this serum- it has a great balance of collagen/structural supporting peptides, neuropeptides, and copper which was exactly what I was looking for. And it's affordable which is a huge plus. I liked the texture as well, it went on smoothly and wasn't oily. However, I had to return this item because of the smell it had on my skin. It smelled like... meat? Eventually the smell went away after a few hours, but I know I won't use it if it's smells even for a little bit. I really wanted to like it!
The Multi-Peptide formulation delivers the essential peptides my aging skin requires leaving it moisturized and plumped! The improvement to my skin continues!

avis.titre: I don't think it's for me
avis.texte: I've had this for a couple months now and tried using it about 1-2x a week and sometimes it's fine, and other times it causes redness and irritation particularly on my lower face, around my mouth (red patches that seem like perioral dermatitis). It does eventually fade, but it makes me feel like it is not worth it. I also cannot quite tell it if does anything (maybe 2 months is not long enough) but I wouldn't repurchase this.

avis.titre: Very moisturizing, help smooth out skin
avis.texte: This serum works so well for my skin! It's lightweight, absorbs quickly. I use it in my nightly routine.

avis.titre: Affordable Cousin to More Expensive Serum
avis.texte: This is not the same as NIOD's copper peptide serum by any mean, but it's still a great copper peptide serum. It has a thicker consistency because of the peptide blend and hyaluronic acid, but it dries down nicely on the skin and layers well with other products. I used this predominantly on my scalp to promote hair grown and also use it on my face when I don't have NIOD. I also use it on old surgical scars to help with smoothing and discoloration.

Use this product sparingly when you start out. When I first about this product, I used it at night then the next morning. That evening, my face started itching, became red, surface became uneven and welts popped up. The instructions stated it could be used in both am/pm skin care routines. I do not have sensitive skin. I knew that i would need to alternate this with my retinal night. I took an antihistamine when the reaction started and it helped lessen the redness and itching but the bumps and uneven skin tecture remained. I had to taken an antihistamine twice a day for several days and use a mild cleanser along with putting aloe gel on ly face before thr reaction went away.
I use this in the morning and at night and my skin's texture and overall tone has improved noticeably.
I love this product. Don't leave your skin and greasy nice little sunshine.

I've tried several more expensive copper peptides including Medik8 and Inn Beauty Elastic Skin and this one is better. The only drawback is the initial copper smell, but it dries away. I recommend for smoother, plumper skin.
No matter how much i hydrate my face, or the amount of products i take out of my routine, this serum does not absorb and peels off.

This copper peptide serum works great for soothing my skin. I have enjoyed using it morning and night but gave it 4 stars only because it becomes a bit sticky on my face. Once I put moisturizer over it the stickiness goes away. Good product.

Most reviews don't leave enough info. I'll be 55 in a few months. I do have an olive skin tone. And while I've not been the best to my body and skin, I do take care of myself. I've used brands ranging from Revision to Obagi to The Ordinary. I don't have a lengthy skin care routine. Give me the most bang for my buck and performance for as little effort as possible. This product does NOT disappoint. It's a staple for me. Word of advice…when using a new product…give your skin time to adjust to new product usage.
I love all their products. I use this one at night, sometimes alone.
I've been buying this since The Ordinary became available. I love it, my skin loves it and I will continue purchase.

I absolutely love this product❤️ it is definitely my favorite peptide serum in my skincare rotation. I am currently on my 3rd bottle and I have seen such an improvement and glow in my skin since bottle #1. Definitely worth the purchase.
This has helped decrease fine lines and imperfections. I love The Ordinary products.

I am currently into skincare and I am so glad I visited Ulta on the day they had a rep from The Ordinary in the store I frequent. The Ordinary offers so many different products however it's important to know what each product does and how it interacts with other products before purchasing. I finally got the answers I needed from an actual rep. This product was recommended for my mature skin along with the hyaluronic B5 which I purchased. Just for reference: mature skin, very oily, sensitive, prone to breakouts. I am on day four of applying this (night routine) after my hyaluronic (first step cleanse, hyaluronic, copper peptides, eye cream)….and I am liking what I am seeing so far. I also alternate every other night with a retinol because she informed me to not use both at the same time….therefore, I alternate). What I am noticing is that my skin is having no reaction to this 👏🏻 other than feeling very moisturized, plump, and dewy and we will see down the road how it handles my faint forehead lines and parenthesis.
I use this daily and like it thus far. It has a faint copper scent and soaks in fairly quickly. I will finish the bottle and decide if I will rebuy.

I absolutely LOVE The Ordinary!!! With these inexpensive products, you can put together a personalized skin care regimen that meets your exact needs without paying for a lot of ingredients you probably don't need and/or going through some expensive customization service. Granted, my regimen consists of about a dozen products, so I could save time by spending more money, but the results I've gotten from the regimen I've put together are undeniable! My skin looks firmer, healthier, and younger. This is probably my favorite product in the line. It moisturizes, tightens, and brightens! Some products I skip on days when I'm in a hurry, but NOT THIS ONE!

Loved this when I first began using it, but about a week into it I noticed my skin began looking orange (like a bad fake tan). Particularly near/around the eyebrows, mouth, & hairline. I'm quite fair skinned so may be better suited for people with darker tones
I've tried a lot of serums but keep coming back to this one. For whatever reason it makes my skin *glow*, and I always notice a difference when I start using it again. I'm constantly impressed!
At first I loved this, made my skin so much brighter but over time it started staining my skin making it orange and blotchy.
Test patch on ny chest before bed. Wokeup with little red clusters in that area. Thank god I didnt use it on my face

avis.titre: I don't recommend this at all
avis.texte: I did not notice any difference with my skin. Any time i use this in the evening i wake up the next day with pimples on my face. Once I stop using it, the pimple goes away.

avis.titre: I would buy this again as long as I live
avis.texte: This is the best product I have ever used. My skin looks so beautiful and I got so many compliments on my skin. am in mid 30s but no one ones knows.
The first use of this product stung when applied. The next few days developed a significant amount of acne, even following the recommended use. Waste of money IMO.

Gifted by Skeepers, I've been using The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% serum, and so far, I love how lightweight and hydrating it is. Excited to see the long-term benefits for my skin from this peptide serum

Great anti-aging serum, noticeable difference in my fine lines and pore size in a few weeks! Kind if reminds me of how my face looked after a microneedling treatment (without the pain!) I use it with the ordinary niacinimide serum and a simple Avene moisturizer, great combo for reducing my dark spots and keeping my oily skin under control.

I've been using this (formerly Buffet) for years with other products from Ordinary. If you layer properly and use Ordinary products it will not pill. When I am consistent with this there is a noticeable difference in my skin. I'll always keep it on hand.

I purchased this with the goal aging gracefully, but I guess I will need to update my review in twenty years to say how that went. In the short term, I found this to be incredibly moisturizing when applied underneath my night time moisturizer. I will keep repurchasing for that reason alone.

avis.titre: This helps reduce my large pores
avis.texte: I'm 52 years old with mostly oily skin. The pores on my nose have always been very noticeable, and sometimes they were so large that I could pluck the sebum from them with tweezers (gross I know). Once I started using this serum that changed, they are now smaller than they have ever been. I used the "Build my Regimen" on The Ordinary's website and this is one of the things that it recommended for me and my skin absolutely loves it. I use this after using the milky toner and before the 100% squalane serum, followed by the moisturizer with beta glucan and my skin has never been happier.

avis.titre: This is my night time staple
avis.texte: I use this nightly underneath my night time moisturizer Excellent product

I have been a huge fan of The Ordinary products for years! After a week of just using The Ordinary Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% Serum For Aging Skin, moisturizer, and sunscreen, I can already tell a huge difference!

avis.titre: The Superstar of my skin care routine
avis.texte: I got gifted and outrageously expensive moisturizer and was really upset when my skin loved it. I looked at the active ingredients and compared them to products I was using and copper peptides were the only one that was new. Luckily I found this product and achieved the same results at a fraction of the price. I have now been using this product for a few years and it's truly my holy grail. I have really dry skin and USED TO struggle with bumpy texture and flakey areas, but this cleared that up. I'm not a super regimented skin care user and can forget from time to time and even so flakes don't immediately return and it takes weeks of being out to see bumps popping back up. I use it in my morning routine because it makes my skin look plumper and me less tired immediately.

avis.titre: One of the best out there.
avis.texte: From the first application, smoother skin at any age. I will always be using this!
This helps keep my mature skin looking bright. I've used other more expensive brands and this works just as well. It's not greasy but it does add hydration.

when i first started using it, i noticed my complexion was looking brighter. but then it started to become a problem not absorbing into my skin well. would cause pilling after i would wait at most an hour to apply my moisturizer…

The Ordinary has been my jam since I first discovered the niacinimide back in 2020. I LOVED the old buffet formula. I want to love the new formuka so bad but it smells like elmers glue. I have a harf time getting past that. Imma use it tho cuz its pricier thsn other 'the ordinary' serums.

I had bought this a while back and was hesitant to try it because i saw in the reviews that it pills but good thing i tried it and the first time i tried it it did pill but i tried it one more time and just used a dropper full and make sure i rub it in until its dried a bit or I used a small fan until it s completely absorbed and i havent seen it pill since and its doing an amazing job with my skin i am pleased and on my second bottle

avis.titre: I loved it but my skin didnt
avis.texte: I bought this in Feb 2024 and used it for about 10 days before my oily, sensitive and acne prone skin reacted to it. I suffered a burning/stinging reaction and had acne breakouts whilst having beautiful glass skin in the process. I stopped the product for 2-3 weeks and restarted it because I really wanted my skin to cooperate but alas the burning sensation restarted again and then I finally gave up. I rebuilt by skin barrier over the next 6 weeks and went back to using the ordinary buffet serum WITHOUT copper which my skin is not allergic to.
I read that we can't use it with vitamine c and acid exfoliant but can we use it with your new exfoliant Saccharomyces Ferment 30% Milky Toner ?

This is my third order for this product. I think what many people don't understand is that you won't see immediate results with any of these products but you will over over time. I have used this product as part,of my regimen for over a year and I can see a noticeable difference in deep wrinkles and the slight ones are gone. I am over 60 yrs old and have previously taken great care with my skin. Peptides are great for skin and combined with copper peptides—over time, expect a mini miracle. I wish it was formulated for Seniors like me containing even more good stuff! I give this product 10 stars and the wish for users that they use it twice a day for over 130 days to see results. The results will speak to you!

I love this product and I also use it with retinol and collagen supplements as well, so I feel like I have a good dynamic trio. Now to get to the actual point of the review I wanted to get to. I noticed in some peoples reviews they notice piling throughout the day or even some issues with mixing certain things. If you go to The Ordinary's website, it tells you what not to mix with their products. And for piling and things- make sure that if you have a water-based skincare routine to not use oils until last step or make sure that you're waiting long enough for your skin care products to absorb. I definitely noticed I had issues with the piling and stuff whenever I wouldn't wait long enough for certain steps to dry or if I applied my sunscreen way too soon. I hope this helps some people!

avis.titre: Great for fine lines and dry skin.
avis.texte: It plumped up my skin, increased glow and made my face soft and radiant. Best product I've bought this year so far.

I wanted to.bring a peptide product in.to my skincare routine. I do have skin barrier, sensitive with rosacea. Mostly just som redness. I put this on and my face is now burning. It's a no go for me. p
This is the one serum I cannot go without. I notice immediate improvements when using the serum. It's my absolute favourite and I use it morning and night under a moisturizer.

Ive inly been usinh this a few days but I like how awake my skin looks in the morning. I also alternate with tretion but Ive been using tret for 2.5 years. It's definitely this serum.

I am brown skin woman in my 30s. I started noticing laugh lines & they began to get deeper! I was determined to find a product that would fight fine lines & hyperpigmentation! This product did just that… It does take time to see a difference. As with all skin care treatments. Have patience, use it consistently & you'll see great results!! Another thing.. I could not use this with Vit C because it decreased the effectiveness of Copper Peptides. Once I figured that out, I began to see great benefits.. Good Luck!

This serum doesn't fully absorb. Generally I wash my face, pat dry, add serum- I'm using about 1/2 dropper full for my entire face and neck- then I wait a few minutes and put moisturizer - Hours later if I rub my face I have 'pilling" where the blue will roll right up under my fingers. It's sitting right on top of my skin and it's just as blue as it is when it comes out of the bottle. This picture is taken 3 hours after it was applied. My skin isn't oily or dry. Aside from normal aging concerns I have no problems at all, so I don't know what's going on with this.
This stuff is giving me painful, very lage cystic acne. I normally have good skin with minimal breakouts, but the way this serum is causing horrible cysts is insane. Will be returning.
I really enjoy this serum. better then biossance to me. I'm on My third bottle and I use it right before moisturizer

Ever since incorporating this into my skincare I've not had a single breakout. This thing is the cure for acne. In my late 20's and started to randomly breakout again. This out that to an end. Love this stuff. So grateful I found it. Yay Google! Lol

I love this product so much to combat signs of aging (almost turning 30). I just have one question how can I combine this with: Azelaic Acid Suspension 10%, Niacinamide 10& + Zinc 1% and 100% L-ascorbic Acid Powder? I would like to use Azelaic Acid Suspension 10%, Multi-Peptide + Copper Peptides 1% serum and Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% daily (morning and evening)? I work from home so I can make sure their are breaks in between using a product on my skin.

avis.titre: Can you use copper peptides with THD vitamin C
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin so don't tolerate LAA vitamin c. Can I use copper peptides in my am routine alongside a THD vitamin C. Current am routine is cleanse, SKII essence, Dear Lucy Antioxidant serum (contains THD vitamin C, alpha arbutin and niacinamide), moisturiser, sunscreen.

I bought this a week ago but have not used it yet because of all the negative comments I have seen. My question is: Can I use vitamin C in the morning and multiprptides copper peptides at night? Will it cause a problem?
I've been using for over a month and I've really noticed a difference in my skin brightness and texture. Will repurchase when it runs out. Only need two drops morning and evening

I'm 68 and on the second bottle I think it does a good job better than the one without the copper (I tried that one as well) my first bottle I noticed a big difference skin looked healthier second bottle not as big a difference but most likely because it's keeping skin in good shape
I have used this for 2 years before my tret 0.05% bec the two work well together per dermatologists. But when I finish the bottle I will try the Naturium product next.

I have added the multi-peptide + copper peptide serum into my skincare routine semi recently and I have noticed huge results already!! I have combination skin and am most concerned about minimizing wrinkles that I have, mostly on my forehead, crows feet and around my glabella from squinting. I use the elf cleansing balm, cerave foaming face wash, Argireline serum and amino acid + b5 serum from the ordinary and cerave face moisturizer. Since adding in the peptide serum I have noticed a huge reduction in my existing wrinkles and my skins appearance overall has improved so much. My skin is more clear and smoother. This serum has made all the difference and I definitely will be repurchasing when I run out. Definitely give it a try!!

I've been using this for three months now and nothing I've ever used has made such a difference in the appearance of my skin. I no longer feel the need to wear foundation, just sunscreen. I'm 65 and my skin has a clear and bright look that I haven't been able to achieve with any other product. I don't even need blush. I haven't changed anything else in my skin care routine except for this serum.

Fantastic product, Unbelievably smooth skin for winter Can definitely say I'll be using this throughout summer too! Keep using it though, I find it losing affect if you pause for a few days. Mulit-peptide + copper peptides sounds like gobbledygook to me Even so, it works so what do I know!?

avis.titre: I would recommend this product to my friends and family.
avis.texte: I love The Ordinary products. They work just as well as skin care lines sold in high end med spas.
Keeps my skin soft, it absorbs quickly, and is far less expensive than the anti-aging serum I was using.
This product is helping my skin better than anything else I've tried! Will definitely be buying more!
After a month of use, it smells SOOOO BAD. Removing it from my routine. Worked took till it starting smelling

I have been using this product for years, since it was called "the Buffet" with Copper and I am so glad that the change in name didn't mean a change in formula. This is my go-to, never fails, never lets me down serum. I use it all year round and it works in the hottest summer and coldest winter to make my skin look as perfect as it can look. This is actually all I wear on my face, no moisturizers or creams over it. This formula smooths out all the problem areas; wrinkles, breakouts, pores. I can't think of any problem this serum can't fix! It's a very pleasant bright blue color (that's the copper effect) and it glides on and spreads evenly. I don't waste a drop of this serum, after I cover my face, any excess that remains on my fingers, I run a little water over them , and rub them on the tops of my hands. Highly recommended!!!
My face loves this product! I've bought it multiple times and keep seeing great results. My face is smoother, brighter and looks better without the help of make up. I use it AM and PM

I just received 3 bottles of liquid product, none of which had plastic safety seals and no indication that they aren't someone else returned products stuffed in a new box. This is not going on my face. Shoddy packaging.
I'm really not sure why this is so loved. I've been using it for a month and don't see any differences to my skin. I wanted to love it, but for the price it's like throwing your money away.
I'm thoroughly enjoying using this product. From the first day I could notice a difference in my skin.

I would love advice on what products and skin care routine to use for signs of aging and revitalising my skin. I have signs of crows feet and forehead lines and feel my skin looks a little drab. any suggestions?

avis.titre: I love this, except the HA - bad for dry climates!
avis.texte: I love all of the ingredients in this product except the HA. I live in a dry climate, where HA pulls moisture from skin toward the drier air...the opposite of how HA works in a moist climate. It is difficult to find products that aren't ruined by the inclusion of HA, which ONLY benefits dry skin in humid climates.

This product is my holy grail, it's really one of the only products I notice a difference with. My pores looks smaller, my acne spots from picking heal quicker… I use it at night with moisturizer after and I love it.
Not noticing a difference except extra pimples. Would not recommend for the price or the lack of ability to use it with certain products.

I got this like 5 or 6 weeks ago. and I've noticed improvement. Not as many fibe lines or anything. The skin looks more bright and less dry and the darker spots or scars are fading. It smells like vinegar is the carrier for this supplement but that scent fades fast and it sinks into the skin well with no residue. It helps heal when I get hormonal stuff around shark week much better than without. I'm buying another bottle tbh.

Why can't this product be used with retinoids? I currently use a peptide serum that I use on nights use tretinoin, is that a bad combination or is it just this product specifically? Can this product we used wtih tretinoin?

I wasn't sure what to expect from this product. I was tired of spending an exuberant amount of $$ on a different brand you can only get online. So far, it's been good. My skin feels smoother. It hasn't been long, so we'll see about other benefits.

avis.titre: Love it but I need advice
avis.texte: Hi, i like a lot the peptides + copper serum. I'm aware that I cannot mix copper peptides with everything. For when I cannot mix it I would like also another one because I want to use peptides more often in my skincare routine. Should I buy Argiline 10% and Matrixyl 10% or just get the multi peptides. serum? Do they contain 10% of Argiline and Matrixyl? I want to get the most of the all properties! Thank you!

I bought this a couple of months ago and use it every morning (I use a retinol product at night). I use this alongside the multi peptide eye serum which I also love. Gives me a nice glow and no irritation. First week using this a friend asked what I was doing to my skin because of the glow (love a compliment!) I use this alongside another brand's ceramide moisturiser and genuinely never been happier with my skin's appearance. I would never have described my skin as dull but now when I don't use this I feel there's a noticeable difference. Would highly recommend!

I like that it tells you that there is 1% copper peptides (GHK- Cu) and you know it due to the brilliant blue color due to it's PH level. Pale blue solutions are either fake or contain a very small amount like 00.01% or 00.02% copper peptides. I started researching Dr. Loren Pickart, the scientist who actually discovered copper peptides and he sells pure 3% blue copper peptide (GHK) serum which I will be trying next on his ReverseSkinAging website

I have noticed the edges of my nails have a yellowish tint, could this product be the problem? I noticed in other comments that is reads not to use your vitamin c serum if using the Buftet product....I use one in the morning and the other at night...it that OK?

I absolutely love this product! I'm 42 and this has smoothed out my lines & even some of my sun damage! Has helped with hydration, but I can only use once a day or it's too strong for me still. I bought after a recommendation from Abbey Yung, and am so grateful for trying!

I'm 41 years old and have been using the Ordinary products for 18+ months now. I have the best skin of my life! I have had cystic acne since I turned 20, and it left scarring. I was able to get my pores and general acne under control with the Niacinamide, but admittedly that didn't deal with the hormonal acne on my chin, just the regular acne. So I went on low-dose 2 month course of Epuris medication (kinda like accutane) and that did the rest. But I completely credit The Ordinary products for bringing my skin back to life after meds clearing it up. The uneven mess from years of scarring is almost unnoticeable now. But the really amazing part is that I haven't gotten a single wrinkle since using this Buffet+Copper peptide serum! I'm 41 and have almost no wrinkles! It's absolutely insane how well this stuff works. I used to have some crows feet when I smile and a few lines between my eyebrows. They're basically gone, or at least so faint I don't even notice them. I look better now at 41 than I did in my 20's and 30's! Plump, bright and clean skin with minimal pores, no wrinkles. Morning and night, I use the squalene cleanser (wiped off with a hot microfiber cloth to exfoliate), then the Niacinamide and Buffet+Copper, then the Moisturizing factors HA. That's it! I also use the moisture factor on my hands and neck/chest and those areas are also unbelievably smooth and wrinkle free. I can't say enough good things about these products.

12 months - 4 bottles total Approximate Use -3-4 days and or nights. Age- 43 / Skin - Normal-Dry I recommend this HIGHLY based off my experience over the last year. Usage- Depending on skin prep with Vit C & Retinol, I use copper peptides on the days/ nights not using C / Retinol or a chemical exfoliant. (for example-I like to take 1-2 days off each week with C so I will use copper peptides - I take 2 nights off each week with retinol and will use a chemical exfoliant or copper peptides…I do what I think my skin needs so this is just an example) Ive NEVER experienced any sensitivites or had any issues with other skin care mixed with this product. I am not sure why the reviews are not better bc I understand the price point is higher than most of the TO products, but honestly its worth every penny. I use the Ulta skin analyis app, and initially noticed when I had stopped using copper peptides briefly last fall my face did not look as bright and my lines were more prominent and not smooth, etc. After reincorporating TO copper peptide + moisturizing factors back into my routine it was obvious that that was the product I needed based off of what I was seeing from my skin analysis results and from my personal observations. This is a holy grail- tried and true - golden staple skin care serum for me. Give yourself 6 weeks and youll likely agree. Especially if you are, of course, doing all of the other things that you're supposed to do to facilitate healthy skin based off of your age,

I bought 6 bottles of this serum during the 2020 black Friday sale (a long time ago, I know) without having ever tried it, but in anticipation of getting great results. Then when I tried it, I was unimpressed. It did nothing for my skin and prevented me from using other products that were more effective. Luckily I hung on to the other bottles, because this past spring, my skin started to look extremely tired and dull, and my old acne scars (which are usually not noticeable) started to become visible. My usual skin care routine was no longer working! So I took a break from exfoliators and gave this product another try, which luckily brought the life and glow back to my skin! So bottom line: definitely consider this if your skin starts to inexplicably look dull. If you skin is already very glowy, then you probably don't need it.
